metaTitle: About Texoma Storm Shelters | FEMA-Certified Safe Room Specialists in Texoma & North Texas
metaDescription: Texoma Storm Shelters: Your trusted source for FEMA-certified storm shelters and safe rooms in North Texas. Protect your family. Call (903) 884-7210.
heroSub: Dedicated to protecting North Texas families with engineered, life-safety storm shelter solutions.
storyHtml:
Texoma Storm Shelters was established to bring certified, engineered tornado safety solutions to homeowners, rural acreage properties, and commercial facilities across North Texas and the Red River valley.

Living in Tornado Alley means severe weather is not a matter of if, but when. We specialize in FEMA P-320 and ICC-500 compliant above-ground safe rooms, underground outdoor bunkers, and garage in-floor shelters that provide impenetrable refuge during violent supercell storms.

Our team works directly with local municipal inspectors in Sherman, Denison, and across Grayson County to ensure every installation exceeds strict structural codes and is properly registered with local emergency dispatch services.

values.title: Life-Safety Engineering
values.desc: We never cut corners on steel gauge, bolt tensile strength, or impact testing ratings.

values.title: Turnkey Local Service
values.desc: From site inspection and permit filing to crane rigging and anchor bolting, we handle the entire project.

values.title: Transparent Pricing & Rebate Support
values.desc: No surprise fees. We actively assist homeowners with Grayson County 50% rebate paperwork.

values.title: Local Emergency Integration
values.desc: Every shelter is GPS mapped and logged with municipal emergency management teams for post-storm rescue.

faq.q: Where are your storm shelters manufactured?
faq.a: Our steel safe rooms and reinforced concrete shelters are fabricated in compliance with Texas Tech Wind Institute and FEMA P-320 standards.
Yes. Our installation crews are factory-trained, licensed, and insured, specializing in structural concrete anchoring and precision excavation.

faq.q: Do you offer financing for storm shelter installations?
faq.a: Yes, we provide flexible financing options to help North Texas homeowners secure certified storm protection with manageable monthly payments.
